                                                                                
 Usage: agentarts gateway create [OPTIONS]                                      
                                                                                
 Create a new gateway                                                           
                                                                                
 Examples:                                                                      
 agentarts gateway create --name my-gateway --description "My Gateway"          
                                                                                
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --name                          -n      <str>  Gateway name                  │
│ --description                   -d      <str>  Gateway description           │
│ --protocol-type                         <str>  Protocol type (default: mcp)  │
│                                                [default: mcp]                │
│ --authorizer-type                       <str>  Authorizer type (default:     │
│                                                iam)                          │
│                                                [default: iam]                │
│ --agency-name                           <str>  Agency name                   │
│ --authorizer-configuration              <str>  Authorizer configuration      │
│                                                (JSON format)                 │
│ --protocol-configuration                <str>  Protocol configuration (JSON  │
│                                                format)                       │
│ --log-delivery-configuration            <str>  Log delivery configuration    │
│                                                (JSON format)                 │
│ --outbound-network-configurat…          <str>  Outbound network              │
│                                                configuration (JSON format)   │
│ --tags                                  <str>  Resource tags (JSON format)   │
│ --skip-ssl-verification         -k             Skip SSL certificate          │
│                                                verification                  │
│ --help                                         Show this message and exit.   │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
